episodes.summary: Day 1 (opens with a flash-forward): a stranger in a black car offers Leo $500 cash to unlock 20 phones tonight, no questions asked. 12 hours earlier Leo was homeless on a train platform with only a bag, a broken phone and an old photo of a smiling girl (WHO IS SHE? - a mystery planted for later). He promises to go from zero to the richest man alive; followers give him $10, likes $1. He earns $8 washing windshields and sells his first repaired phone for $20. The deal timer is running. Cash: $28.
